name: PartSnap Evidence Graph source registry
purpose: Make PartSnap less gimmicky by grounding AI photo results in source-ranked part families, diagrams, model aliases, proof requirements, and human-reviewed corrections.

source_tiers.label: official_manufacturer
source_tiers.confidence_rule: Can support likely family or visible-marking confidence only when the scan also sees matching proof such as brand, model plate, molded number, or matching diagram clue.

source_tiers.label: authorized_distributor_catalog
source_tiers.confidence_rule: Use as cross-check and search help. Do not claim stock, price, availability, or official fitment unless the partner feed explicitly allows it.

source_tiers.label: public_parts_diagram_vendor
source_tiers.confidence_rule: Helpful for aliases and diagrams, but not a source of manufacturer verification unless the page cites the OEM document.

source_tiers.label: field_feedback
source_tiers.confidence_rule: Never raises confidence by itself. It creates review tickets that can become verified corpus entries after human or partner review.

sources.source_type: official replacement parts catalog by category
sources.notes: Official category PDFs and part catalogs. Use for model family, part number, category, diagram/source link, and proof requirements.
Pentair says catalog updates are made quarterly. Use as new-tech radar and current SKU update lane.

sources.source_type: official connected variable-speed and flow pump product page
sources.notes: Use for IntelliFlo3/IntelliPro3 family language, app connectivity, optional I/O board/touchscreen references, item-number aliases, and proof prompts. Do not copy marketing savings claims into diagnostics or ordering recommendations.
Use for source-backed proof prompts around Wi-Fi/Bluetooth connectivity, RS-485 automation, dry-start/loss-of-prime clues, smart priming, flexible demand, and qualified electrical safety boundaries.
Use as market intelligence that connected pump data is becoming a service workflow. Mention Pool Brain only as a third-party integration reference, not as SplashLens terminology or endorsement.
Use for model/manual links, safety language, and part-proof prompts. Parts lists may be in individual manuals.

sources.source_type: official buyer guide and parts list
sources.notes: Use where accessible for current product and parts-list indexing.
Official page points to genuine Jandy replacement parts. Use for partner/outreach ask and verified cards.

sources.source_type: official product catalog and genuine parts route
sources.notes: Use for official catalog link and Fluidra partner card ask. Do not imply Fluidra approval without written agreement.
Use for robot part categories and genuine-part language. Pair with diagrams only when source terms allow.
Use as a distributor search/index lane where allowed. Do not scrape logged-in pricing or account-only content.

sources.source_type: public parts diagrams and retail part pages
sources.notes: Use for public page links and affiliate/part-search discussions. Prefer partnership or permitted exports before bulk ingestion.
Use as a secondary diagram reference, not a primary verification authority.
Use for spa-pack family names, display/keypad language, and safe proof prompts. Do not infer electrical repair instructions.
Use for Gecko control-family names, app-pairing proof, and configuration-aware proof prompts.
Use for pump/wet-end family language and proof prompts around orientation, unions, labels, and role.

sources.source_type: official hot tub and swim spa owner manuals
sources.notes: Use for swim-spa proof prompts and operator workflows, not internal electrical diagnosis.
Use for brand/model proof prompts and owner/operator workflows.
Use for swim-spa and hot-tub family proof prompts.

sources.source_type: user-submitted mystery part and wrong/missing feedback
sources.notes: Stored by functions/api/partsnap-feedback.js and reviewed by functions/api/partsnap-review.js.

non_negotiables: Never mark partner-verified without written partner approval.
Never claim exact fit from AI alone.
Every result should show source tier, visible evidence, missing proof, and verification path.
Retail/distributor links are convenience paths, not endorsement or guaranteed availability.
Manufacturer manuals and safety instructions outrank distributor and public diagram pages.
